Title: Siero Luce
Body (HTML): A lightweight vitamin C serum for a brighter, more even-looking complexion. Absorbs in seconds and sits well under sunscreen.
Benefits (product.metafields.custom.bene:
Visibly brighter skin
Helps even out tone
Antioxidant support every morning
How to use (product.metafields.custom.ho: Morning: 3–4 drops on clean skin, before moisturiser and SPF.

Title: Notte Retinale
Body (HTML): A rich night cream with retinal to smooth the look of fine lines and refine texture while you sleep.
Benefits (product.metafields.custom.bene:
Smoother-looking skin
Refined texture
Cushioned with squalane and ceramides
How to use (product.metafields.custom.ho: Evening, 2–3 times a week at first, then nightly. Pause before and after laser or peel treatments as advised by your doctor. Not recommended during pregnancy.

Title: Gel Purificante

Benefits (product.metafields.custom.bene:
Less shine through the day
Pores look refined
Light, oil-free texture
How to use (product.metafields.custom.ho: Morning and evening on clean skin, alone or under moisturiser.
Ingredients (product.metafields.custom.i: Niacinamide 5%, zinc PCA, green tea extract.

Title: Crema Barriera
Body (HTML): A comforting moisturiser that supports the skin barrier, ideal in the days after peels, lasers and microneedling.
Benefits (product.metafields.custom.bene:
Soothes tight, dry skin
Supports the skin barrier
Fragrance-free
How to use (product.metafields.custom.ho: Morning and evening as the last step before SPF.

Benefits (product.metafields.custom.bene:
Cleans without stripping
Suitable after treatments
For all skin types

Ingredients (product.metafields.custom.i: Glycerin, oat extract, mild plant-based cleansers.

Title: Schermo SPF 50

SPF 50 broad-spectrum
Sheer, no white cast
Suitable for sensitive skin
How to use (product.metafields.custom.ho: Every morning as the last step. Reapply every two hours in the sun.
Ingredients (product.metafields.custom.i: Zinc oxide, titanium dioxide, vitamin E.

Gentle on the scalp
Leaves hair soft
Suitable after hair treatments
